profile.headline: CTO at Pallet
profile.summary: I love building products for the Web—everything from sketching wireframes to constructing prototypes to writing production-ready HTML, CSS, and Javascript. Tools of choice: Sketch for designing, NodeJS/Express for backend, Webpack/React/Netlify for frontend, Jest for unit testing, Selenium for end-to-end testing.

positions.title: Manager, Frontend Engineering
positions.description: Managing a team responsible for developing shared front-end engineering services across the company, including our internal front-end framework, design system, and the associated React component libraries.

positions.title: Senior Product Designer
positions.description: Responsibilities evolved to include managing the development of our internal design framework, interviewing candidates for front-end developer positions, and building front-end interfaces using AngularJS.

positions.title: Product Designer
positions.description: Product requirements gathering, working closely with Product Managers to determine key use cases, conducting customer interviews to understand their pain points, designing interfaces that simplify complex processes related to programmatic advertising.

positions.title: Freelance Graphics Editor
positions.description: Working with writers and designers to put together interactive pieces for the Web site. Position requires extensive knowledge of Javascript and many related frameworks.

positions.title: Graphics Intern
positions.description: Working with writers and designers to put together interactive pieces for the Web site. Position requires extensive knowledge of Javascript and many related frameworks.

positions.title: Editorial Production Associate
positions.description: Laying out each week's articles using InDesign, assisting in the design and creation of The New Yorker's iPad and Android editions, developing tools to improve the print-to-web workflow and allow for automation.

positions.title: Web Intern
positions.description:
Created motion graphics videos to complement articles written by David Brooks and Tad Friend.
Aggregated and prototyped visual features for the blog.
Used the Twitter API to build a build a feed that conformed with New Yorker style guidelines.

positions.title: Online Editor
positions.description: Using the Drupal framework to build a news publishing website with hourly updates, visited by over 5,000 unique individuals daily.

positions.title: Multimedia Editor
positions.description: Editing reporters' raw footage to create videos to supplement their articles; assembling audio slideshows featuring original photographs and narration from reporters.

positions.title: Multimedia Assistant
positions.description:
Served as cameraman to record lectures delivered at the graduate school
Transcoded the recorded videos to usable file format and uploaded them to the company's FTP

positions.title: Press Research Intern
positions.description: Driving the daily production of the "Press Digest," a packet aggregating every daily news article mentioning the Mayor or New York City; coordinating with the Press Office to determine which articles will require a further review by the Mayor and his staff; sitting in on New York City press conferences and later transcribing them for archival purposes

honors.title: Best in Insight
honors.description: My project, DoesCongressReallySuck.com won the award for "Best in Insight."

volunteerExperiences.description: Consulted on rebranding for the organization, assisted in preparing speaking points for nationwide initiatives, spoke on behalf of the organization at fundraisers and community-outreach events.
